item.title: US Supreme Court strikes down Donald Trump’s tariffs; Full story here
item.description: In a major ruling with global economic impact, the US Supreme Court has invalidated former President Donald Trump’s sweeping tariffs, saying he exceeded his authority by invoking a national emergency law without clear approval from Congress.

item.title: Weather Update: IMD issues heavy rain alert for South India; Temperature to rise in North
item.description: The India Meteorological Department has forecast heavy rainfall in parts of Tamil Nadu and Kerala between February 21 and 23, accompanied by strong winds. Coastal and sea regions may witness gusts up to 60 kmph, prompting advisories for fishermen.

item.title: Donald Trump hits back with 10% global tariff after Supreme Court blow; Full details
item.description: After a major setback from the U.S. Supreme Court, President Donald Trump has announced a sweeping 10% global tariff under Section 122 of the 1974 Trade Act. The move, effective February 24, will last five months and adds to existing duties.

item.title: Delhi traffic advisory issued for AI Impact Summit 2026; VVIP movement triggers diversions across Central Delhi
item.description: Delhi Traffic Police has issued a detailed advisory due to the AI Impact Summit 2026 at Bharat Mandapam. Several key routes, including Bhairon Road and Mathura Road, will remain affected from 9 am to 8 pm amid heavy VVIP movement.

item.title: IND vs SA: Abhishek out of form, Surya-Ishan silent; Who saves India against South Africa?
item.description: India will take on South Africa in the Super 8 stage of the T20 World Cup 2026 at Narendra Modi Stadium. With Abhishek Sharma struggling for form and inconsistent performances from the top order, concerns loom over India’s batting strength.

item.title: PM Modi’s Israel visit set to boost strategic defence ties; Anti-ballistic missile deal likely
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will visit Israel for two days to enhance strategic and defence cooperation with Benjamin Netanyahu. Discussions may include anti-ballistic missile systems, laser-based defence technology, long-range missiles, and advanced drones.

item.title: Crime Branch issues lookout notice against Harry Boxer in Ranveer Singh threat case
item.description: Mumbai Crime Branch has issued a lookout circular against alleged gangster associate Harry Boxer in connection with a threat and ₹20 crore extortion demand targeting Ranveer Singh. The threatening voice note, reportedly sent from a US number, was verified with agencies in Punjab and Haryana.

item.title: Terror Alert In Delhi: LeT suspected of plotting attack on Chandni Chowk Temples
item.description: Intelligence inputs indicate that suspected sleeper cells linked to LeT may attempt to plant an improvised explosive device (IED) in a crowded area near the main gate of the historic Red Fort.

item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: Oman, Namibia, Canada winless but set to receive prize money; See how much
item.description: In T20 World Cup 2026, Oman, Namibia, and Canada failed to win any matches but will still receive significant prize money from the ICC. Despite losing all group-stage games, these associate nations are set to earn around $2 million each, aiding player development, cricket infrastructure, and future preparations.
